cond_0001.intro:
The Research Scientist will provide scientific and technical support to management of research projects and oversee multiple concurrent solicitations, proposal review processes, contract awards and funding execution at the program level. This position will provide domain expertise and assist in coordinating the efforts of a multi-disciplinary team of government and contract researchers, clinicians, academic experts and consumers to bring all the various projects in their domain together into a cohesive effort.
This position is assigned to [Location masked]. A thorough government background check will be required.
About The Project
Modulation of Rescuecompetent MicroRNAs in Cystic Fibrosis Lungs. Responsible for conducting all experiments, data analysis, and assisting with the maintenance of the laboratory.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Review research documentation and provide detailed technical written notes
Perform recurring analyses on research portfolios to identify critical gaps, exceptional results and/or lack of progress
Interact with other services and government agencies, organize and host research planning and coordination meetings, and inform the Principal Investigator of developments
Assist with various portfolios and technology roadmaps, within the context of the overall strategy
Maintain open communication with the Principal Investigator, advise of processes, report progress and serve as a point of contact, as applicable
Provide guidance to scientists preparing research proposals, to include guidance on research protocol development, as needed
Author or co-author topics to help move through the technology roadmap for domain
Participate in the drafting of program announcements, requests for information, proposals and vehicles to solicit offertory
Perform scientific reviews on research proposals submitted for consideration, as requested
Participate in Proposal Review Board meetings and make funding recommendations that are consistent with the scientific direction and technology roadmap for domain
Participate in multifunctional teams and provide clinical and scientific domain expertise as needed
Maintain and update files of all applicable regulatory documentation for IACUC or IRB (including protocols, approvals, amendments, modifications, etc.) as well as any communications with the sponsor or any other Federal or regulatory office (including prior approvals, change in scope, etc.)
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelors or RN degree
2-4 Years knowledge and experience with Department of Defense (DoD) Grants and Agreements administration and management
Demonstrate competence in oral and written communication
Must be organized, attentive to detail, and possess a positive, friendly and professional demeanor
Ability to be flexible with changing priorities and available to interact with employees, clients and sponsors of all levels
Ability to exercise independent judgment in high-pressured environment with strict deadlines and to manage multiple projects
Ability to develop strong trusting relationships in order to gain support and achieve results
Computer skills including at least intermediate level experience with Excel and other Microsoft Office Software
Preferred Requirements
Advanced Degree (Masters, PhD or MD)
2-4 Years Medical research project management experience, preferably with Department of Defense
Experience with advanced medical technologies
Knowledge of military system

Modulation of Rescuecompetent MicroRNAs in Cystic Fibrosis Lungs. Responsible for conducting all experiments, data analysis, and assisting with the maintenance of the laboratory.

This position will provide domain expertise and assist in coordinating the efforts of a multi-disciplinary team of government and contract researchers, clinicians, academic experts and consumers to bring all the various projects in their domain together into a cohesive effort.
This position is assigned to [Location masked]. A thorough government background check will be required.
About The Project
Modulation of Rescuecompetent MicroRNAs in Cystic Fibrosis Lungs. Responsible for conducting all experiments, data analysis, and assisting with the maintenance of the laboratory.
cond_0361.responsibilities:
Review research documentation and provide detailed technical written notes
Perform recurring analyses on research portfolios to identify critical gaps, exceptional results and/or lack of progress
Interact with other services and government agencies, organize and host research planning and coordination meetings, and inform the Principal Investigator of developments
Assist with various portfolios and technology roadmaps, within the context of the overall strategy
Maintain open communication with the Principal Investigator, advise of processes, report progress and serve as a point of contact, as applicable
Provide guidance to scientists preparing research proposals, to include guidance on research protocol development, as needed
Author or co-author topics to help move through the technology roadmap for domain
Participate in the drafting of program announcements, requests for information, proposals and vehicles to solicit offertory
Perform scientific reviews on research proposals submitted for consideration, as requested
Participate in Proposal Review Board meetings and make funding recommendations that are consistent with the scientific direction and technology roadmap for domain
Participate in multifunctional teams and provide clinical and scientific domain expertise as needed
Maintain and update files of all applicable regulatory documentation for IACUC or IRB (including protocols, approvals, amendments, modifications, etc.) as well as any communications with the sponsor or any other Federal or regulatory office (including prior approvals, change in scope, etc.)
cond_0361.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelors or RN degree
2-4 Years knowledge and experience with Department of Defense (DoD) Grants and Agreements administration and management
Demonstrate competence in oral and written communication
Must be organized, attentive to detail, and possess a positive, friendly and professional demeanor
Ability to be flexible with changing priorities and available to interact with employees, clients and sponsors of all levels
Ability to exercise independent judgment in high-pressured environment with strict deadlines and to manage multiple projects
Ability to develop strong trusting relationships in order to gain support and achieve results
Computer skills including at least intermediate level experience with Excel and other Microsoft Office Software
Preferred Requirements
Advanced Degree (Masters, PhD or MD)
2-4 Years Medical research project management experience, preferably with Department of Defense
Experience with advanced medical technologies
Knowledge of military system

cond_0361.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

A large part of the role is staying in regular contact with a multi-disciplinary team of government and contract researchers, clinicians, academic experts and consumers to bring all the various projects in their domain together into a cohesive effort.
This position is assigned to [Location masked]. A thorough government background check will be required.
Modulation of Rescuecompetent MicroRNAs in Cystic Fibrosis Lungs. Responsible for conducting all experiments, data analysis, and assisting with the maintenance of the laboratory.
cond_0645.responsibilities:
Review research documentation and provide detailed technical written notes
Perform recurring analyses on research portfolios to identify critical gaps, exceptional results and/or lack of progress
Actively connect with other services and government agencies, organize and host research planning and coordination meetings, and keep the Principal Investigator informed of developments
Assist with various portfolios and technology roadmaps, within the context of the overall strategy
Maintain open, ongoing communication with the Principal Investigator, advise of processes, report progress and serve as a point of contact, as applicable
Provide guidance to scientists preparing research proposals, including walking them through research protocol development, as needed
Author or co-author topics to help move through the technology roadmap for domain
Actively contribute to the drafting of program announcements, requests for information, proposals and vehicles to solicit offertory
Perform scientific reviews on research proposals submitted for consideration, as requested
Participate in Proposal Review Board meetings, speak up with funding recommendations that are consistent with the scientific direction and technology roadmap for domain
Participate in multifunctional teams and regularly share clinical and scientific domain expertise as needed
Maintain and update files of all applicable regulatory documentation for IACUC or IRB (including protocols, approvals, amendments, modifications, etc.) as well as any communications with the sponsor or any other Federal or regulatory office (including prior approvals, change in scope, etc.)
cond_0645.requirements:
Advanced Degree (Masters, PhD or MD) desired, Bachelors or RN required
2-4 Years knowledge and experience with Department of Defense (DoD) Grants and Agreements administration and management
2-4 Years Medical research project management experience strongly desired, preferably with Department of Defense
Experience with advanced medical technologies, preferred
Knowledge of military system, preferred
Demonstrate competence in oral and written communication
Must be organized, attentive to detail, and possess a positive, friendly and professional demeanor
Comfortable interacting with employees, clients and sponsors at all levels, and able to adapt to changing priorities
Ability to exercise independent judgment with strict deadlines and to manage multiple projects
Ability to develop strong trusting relationships in order to gain support and achieve results
Computer skills including at least intermediate level experience with Excel and other Microsoft Office Software
